channel.title: Edge of History
channel.description: The famous story is never the whole story. Nora Vance, a former tabloid reporter who always asks "who profited?", and Cal Whitlock, a former history teacher who always asks "what's the source?", take the most famous and infamous events in history and tell the side almost nobody has heard. They bicker, they bet (Cal always loses), and then they tell you about the person history forgot. Nora and Cal are fictional hosts voiced with AI text-to-speech; the history is real and every episode lists its sources.
